errors.evidence: The description identifies the color of the largest sector as 'blue-gray' ('синьо-сив'), when it is clearly blue in the chart.
This phrase ('Due to their small visual size,') introduces an interpretation or justification, which is not a direct description of the visual content.

The description incorrectly identifies the color of the smallest sector ('Концесии за строителство') as 'blue-gray' ('синьо-сив'); it is light blue/cyan. This is a major error because it uses the same incorrect color descriptor for two different categories (the 80.3% and 0.7% slices), causing confusion.

The description incorrectly states that the percentage labels are 'written inside the respective sectors' ('изписани вътре в съответните сектори'), whereas they are clearly located outside, next to the slices.
